# Dream Journal

A Skill Harbor house build, sister skill to Celestial Journal, for the other half of the night. Dream Journal starts from a simple fact: a dream fades within minutes of waking, and the tool that is actually there at that moment is the chat you already use. You dictate, even three words, even "nothing this morning", and your Muse captures the story verbatim before asking anything, then files it with its emotion, its people and places, its clarity, and the Moon phase of the night, all in a folder that stays on your device.

Over weeks, the journal starts answering back with counts, not claims. Your recall rate, honestly divided by the mornings you remembered nothing. Your recurring dream signs, the staircase, the house, the person who keeps appearing, counted across your own entries. If you believe some of your dreams announce things, the skill keeps an honest register: the dream is dated when you dream it, and after the fact you give the verdict, happened, didn't happen, in between, with the misses kept in the count, like the hits.

Interpretation is a lens you choose at setup (none, psychological, traditional-symbolic, spiritual) and can change any time; a small traditional symbol dictionary is included, labelled as tradition, and your own journal's history outranks it. An optional lucid-dreaming module builds your evening intention from your #1 dream sign and logs which techniques actually work for you, with sleep itself always ranked above performance. Free to use under...
